ideas.idea: Add `site` to Astro config and derive canonicals and sitemap from it
ideas.why: There is no astro.config, the origin is hardcoded, and a single source of truth would help fix the canonical.

ideas.idea: Mark up the harbour office phone and location as LocalBusiness structured data
ideas.why: This is accurate, but the report itself says it only helps if the page is indexable, and /contact is noindex.

ideas.idea: Add seasonal prices and mooring sizes to the moorings page text, since the description promises them
ideas.why: The page has only one price sentence and no sizes or seasonal prices, so the description's promise goes unmet.

ideas.idea: Put the water-taxi details (May to September) in visible page text
ideas.why: The only mention of the dates is in the FAQ JSON-LD, which is broken, so the facts are not in the page text.

ideas.idea: Add og: social tags to the layout
ideas.why: This is accurate, but social preview tags are standard advice and do little to help machines find or read the site.

ideas.idea: Add meta charset and viewport to Base.astro
ideas.why: The head does lack both, but this is standard boilerplate with a small effect on discoverability.

ideas.idea: Add a <main> landmark and a link from the moorings page to /contact
ideas.why: This is accurate, but landmarks and an extra internal link have little effect, and a link to a noindex page does not help discovery.

ideas.idea: Change the robots default to `index, follow` or remove the tag
ideas.why: This is a concrete fix, but it duplicates the known max-snippet:0 problem, so it should be left out; it is kept only as the fix for that problem.
